description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/family_data_spec.json to understand what data to import. (2) Navigate to /workspace/family-steward and use the Family Steward tool API (TypeScript tools or CLI) to add 4 family members (with generation, relationship, DOB fields), 3 contacts (with categories: legal/financial/medical), and 3 documents (with expiryDate and nextReviewDate). (3) Use tools.log_contact_interaction() with the correct contactId and interaction object to log Marcus Blackwell's annual trust review meeting. (4) Use tools.complete_task() on the Q3 tax payment task. (5) Query the system using tools.get_dashboard(), tools.get_upcoming_birthdays(30), tools.get_contacts_needing_followup(7), tools.get_expiring_documents(90), tools.get_documents_needing_review(30), and tools.get_overdue_tasks(). (6) Synthesize query results into /workspace/family_office_report.json with the exact required keys. The proprietary trap: values must come from the live system (not from manually counting the spec file), so agents must use the correct tool parameter windows (30 days for birthdays, 7 days for followup, 90 days for expiry, 30 days for review). Eleanor's birthday in 20 days = 1 result. Marcus's followup in 3 days = 1 result. Trust (60d) + IMA (45d) expiring = 2. Trust (15d) + IMA (20d) reviews = 2. Tax task overdue = 1. Completed = 1 after complete_task() is called.
